ask.text: Spare a coin for an old traveller? I've walked further than anyone in this valley, you know.

choices.text: Tell me about your travels first.
Sorry, I have nothing to spare.

travels.text: West, a cliff like a wall, with a cave at its foot that growls at night. North-east, the hill where the star fell. South-east, a lake with a pillar reaching for the sky. Treasures hide where people fear or forget.

ok.text: Ah, well. The road is long. May it be kind to you.

grateful.text: Bless you, {name}. A secret for your kindness: the stone pillar in the lake? Climb it. The star left something at the top.

scorn.text: ...I had a job once. I had a lot of things once. Off with you.

choices.text: I'm sorry for what I said.

forgive.text: ...Apology accepted. Words are cheap, but they're a start.

after.text: The wind is kind today, {name}. Did you climb the pillar yet?
